theorem exists_forward_coprime_covariance {lam : ℕ → ℝ} (hW : WeilPositiveFull lam) :
    ∃ (V : ℝ) (r : ℕ → ℝ), 0 ≤ V ∧
      Tendsto (fun N : ℕ => (∑ n ∈ Finset.Icc 1 N,
        ‖sourceCoeff lam n - sourceCompletion hW 1‖ ^ 2 / n) / Real.log N)
        atTop (𝓝 V) ∧
      (∀ Q : ℕ, Q ≠ 0 → 0 < r Q ∧
        Tendsto (fun s : ℝ => LSeries (coprimePart Q (sourceCoeff lam)) (s : ℂ) /
          LSeries (sourceCoeff lam) (s : ℂ)) (𝓝[>] 1) (𝓝 (r Q : ℂ))) ∧
      ∀ (S : Finset ℕ), (∀ Q ∈ S, Q ≠ 0) → ∀ c : ℕ → ℝ,
        ‖sourceCompletion hW 1‖ ^ 2 *
          (∑ Q ∈ S, c Q * (r Q - coprimeDensity Q)) ^ 2 ≤
        V * ∑ Q ∈ S, ∑ R ∈ S, c Q * c R *
          (coprimeDensity (Q * R) - coprimeDensity Q * coprimeDensity R)

theorem exists_forward_coprime_covariance {lam : ℕ → ℝ} (hW : WeilPositiveFull lam) :
    ∃ (V : ℝ) (r : ℕ → ℝ), 0 ≤ V ∧
      Tendsto (fun N : ℕ => (∑ n ∈ Finset.Icc 1 N,
        ‖sourceCoeff lam n - sourceCompletion hW 1‖ ^ 2 / n) / Real.log N)
        atTop (𝓝 V) ∧
      (∀ Q : ℕ, Q ≠ 0 → 0 < r Q ∧
        Tendsto (fun s : ℝ => LSeries (coprimePart Q (sourceCoeff lam)) (s : ℂ) /
          LSeries (sourceCoeff lam) (s : ℂ)) (𝓝[>] 1) (𝓝 (r Q : ℂ))) ∧
      ∀ (S : Finset ℕ), (∀ Q ∈ S, Q ≠ 0) → ∀ c : ℕ → ℝ,
        ‖sourceCompletion hW 1‖ ^ 2 *
          (∑ Q ∈ S, c Q * (r Q - coprimeDensity Q)) ^ 2 ≤
        V * ∑ Q ∈ S, ∑ R ∈ S, c Q * c R *
          (coprimeDensity (Q * R) - coprimeDensity Q * coprimeDensity R)
source_arguments.proof_excerpt:
by
  classical
  obtain ⟨_, V, _, hV0, _, _, hV⟩ := exists_forwardCoeff_energy_variance hW
  simp only [forwardCoeff_eq_sourceCoeff] at hV
  have hex (Q : ℕ) : ∃ r : ℝ, Q ≠ 0 → 0 < r ∧
      Tendsto (fun s : ℝ => LSeries (coprimePart Q (sourceCoeff lam)) (s : ℂ) /
        LSeries (sourceCoeff lam) (s : ℂ)) (𝓝[>] 1) (𝓝 (r : ℂ)) := by
    by_cases hQ : Q = 0
    · exact ⟨0, fun h => (h hQ).elim⟩
    haveI : NeZero Q := ⟨hQ⟩
    obtain ⟨r, _, _, hr, _, _, hRatio, _⟩ := exists_coprime_source_ratio_limit hW Q
    exact ⟨r, fun _ => ⟨hr, hRatio⟩⟩
  choose r hr using hex
  refine ⟨V, r, hV0, hV, hr, ?_⟩
  intro S hS c
  let B := sourceCompletion hW 1
  let f : ℕ → ℂ := fun n => sourceCoeff lam n - B
  let b : ℝ := -(∑ Q ∈ S, c Q * coprimeDensity Q)
  have he : Tendsto (fun N : ℕ =>
      weightPartialSum (fun n => ‖f n‖ ^ 2 / n) N / Real.log N) atTop (𝓝 V) := by
    apply hV.congr
    intro N
    congr 1
    unfold weightPartialSum
    apply Finset.sum_subset
    · intro n hn
      exact Finset.mem_Icc.mpr ⟨by omega, (Finset.mem_Icc.mp hn).2⟩
    · intro n hn hn'
      have hn0 : n = 0 := by
        have := Finset.mem_Icc.mp hn
        by_contra hn0
        exact hn' (Finset.mem_Icc.mpr ⟨by omega, this.2⟩)
      simp [hn0]
  have hR := coprimeAffineMask_residue S id c b
    (fun _ hs => summable_centered_source hW hs) (centered_source_residue hW)
    (fun Q hQ => by
      haveI : NeZero Q := ⟨hS Q hQ⟩
      exact centered_coprime_source_residue hW Q (hr Q (hS Q hQ)).2)
  have hlim : ((b : ℂ) * 0 + ∑ Q ∈ S,
      (c Q : ℂ) * (B * ((r Q - coprimeDensity Q : ℝ) : ℂ))) =
      B * ((∑ Q ∈ S, c Q * (r Q - coprimeDensity Q) : ℝ) : ℂ) := by
    simp only [mul_zero, zero_add, Complex.ofReal_sum, Complex.ofReal_mul, Finset.mul_sum]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro Q _
    ring
  rw [hlim] at hR
  have hb := norm_masked_residue_sq_le_log_energy hV0 he
    (fun s hs => summable_coprimeAffineMask_mul S id c b (summable_centered_source hW hs))
    (fun s hs => summable_coprimeAffineMask_square S id c b hs)
    (coprimeAffineMask_square_residue S id hS c b) hR
  have hD : coprimeAffineSquareDensity S id c b =
      ∑ Q ∈ S, ∑ R ∈ S, c Q * c R *
        (coprimeDensity (Q * R) - coprimeDensity Q * coprimeDensity R) :=
    coprimeAffineSquareDensity_centered S id c
  rw [hD, norm_mul, mul_pow,
    Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs, sq_abs] at hb
  exact hb

  refine ⟨R, hRd, hRF, ?_, hRg⟩
  let A := dirichletSum (fun n => sourceCoeff lam (n + 1) - sourceCompletion hW 1)
  have hAc : ContinuousAt A 1 :=

      (centered_forward_dirichletConvergesAt hW (s := (5 / 8 : ℂ)) (by norm_num))).differentiableAt
        ((isOpen_lt continuous_const Complex.continuous_re).mem_nhds (by norm_num))).continuousAt
  have hRc : ContinuousAt R 1 := (hRd.differentiableAt
    ((isOpen_lt continuous_const Complex.continuous_re).mem_nhds (by norm_num))).continuousAt
  have hcast := tendsto_ofReal_nhdsWithin_ne_one.mono_right nhdsWithin_le_nhds
  have hcont : ContinuousAt
      (fun s : ℂ => A s + sourceCompletion hW 1 * riemannZeta₀ s) 1 :=
    hAc.add (continuousAt_const.mul (differentiable_riemannZeta₀ 1).continuousAt)
  have hlim := hcont.tendsto.comp hcast

    change A (s : ℂ) + sourceCompletion hW 1 * riemannZeta₀ (s : ℂ) = R (s : ℂ)
    rw [hRF (s : ℂ) hs, show A (s : ℂ) = _ from quantization_centered_dirichlet_eq hW hs,

    ring

  have hC0 : 0 ≤ C := (norm_nonneg _).trans (hbound 0)
  refine ⟨4 * C, by positivity, fun N hN => ?_⟩
  have ht := norm_dirichletSum_sub_partialSum_le hbound
    (s := 1) (by norm_num) (centered_forward_dirichletConvergesAt hW (by norm_num)) N
  have he : (1 : ℂ) - 5 / 8 = ((3 / 8 : ℝ) : ℂ) := by norm_num
  rw [he] at ht
  norm_num [Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs] at ht
  have ht' : ‖dirichletSum a 1 - dirichletPartialSum a N 1‖ ≤
      4 * C * ((N : ℝ) + 1) ^ (-(3 / 8 : ℝ)) := by
    convert ht using 1; ring
  have hp : (0 : ℝ) < N := by exact_mod_cast hN
  exact ht'.trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
    (Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_nonpos (y := (N : ℝ) + 1)
      (z := -(3 / 8 : ℝ)) hp (by linarith) (by norm_num)) (by positivity))

      |quantizationHarmonicSum lam N - (sourceCompletion hW 1).re * Real.log N -

  obtain ⟨C, hC, htail⟩ := quantization_centered_harmonic_tail hW
  refine ⟨C + |(sourceCompletion hW 1).re|, by positivity, fun N hN => ?_⟩
  let L := dirichletSum (fun n => sourceCoeff lam (n + 1) - sourceCompletion hW 1) 1
  let b := (sourceCompletion hW 1).re

pays both coordinates of the logarithmic mean. No mean is postulated.

open Complex Filter Topology

private theorem sum_Icc_one_eq_range {A : Type*} [AddCommMonoid A]
    (f : ℕ → A) (N : ℕ) :
    ∑ n ∈ Finset.Icc 1 N, f n = ∑ n ∈ Finset.range N, f (n + 1) := by
  induction N with
  | zero => simp
  | succ N ih =>
    rw [Finset.sum_Icc_succ_top (by omega), Finset.sum_range_succ, ih]

/-- The two existing definitions use exactly the same truncated logarithm. -/
theorem forwardCoeff_eq_sourceCoeff (lam : ℕ → ℝ) :
    forwardCoeff lam = WeilWorkSettledPhase.sourceCoeff lam := by
  unfold forwardCoeff WeilWorkSettledPhase.sourceCoeff
  congr 1
  funext n
  simp only [logZetaCoeff, IntegerMassRigidity.lamLog]
  split_ifs <;> simp [Complex.ofReal_div]

/-- Ordinary harmonic convergence after centering at the literal pole residue. -/
theorem exists_centered_forward_harmonic_limit {lam : ℕ → ℝ}
    (hW : WeilPositiveFull lam) :
    ∃ L : ℂ, Tendsto (fun N : ℕ => ∑ n ∈ Finset.Icc 1 N,
      (forwardCoeff lam n - WeilWorkSettledPhase.sourceCompletion hW 1) / n)
        atTop (𝓝 L) := by
  obtain ⟨L, hL⟩ := WeilWorkSettledPhase.centered_forward_dirichletConvergesAt
    hW (s := 1) (by norm_num)
  refine ⟨L, hL.congr fun N => ?_⟩
  rw [sum_Icc_one_eq_range]
  simp [dirichletPartialSum, Complex.cpow_neg_one, forwardCoeff_eq_sourceCoeff,
    Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one, div_eq_mul_inv]

/-- The harmonic weight has leading coefficient one. -/
theorem tendsto_harmonic_weight_div_log :
    Tendsto (fun N : ℕ => (∑ n ∈ Finset.Icc 1 N, (1 : ℝ) / n) / Real.log N)
      atTop (𝓝 1) := by
  have hlog : Tendsto (fun N : ℕ => Real.log N) atTop atTop :=
    Real.tendsto_log_atTop.comp tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop
  have ht := (Real.tendsto_harmonic_sub_log.div_atTop hlog).add_const 1
  simp only [zero_add] at ht
  refine ht.congr' ?_
  filter_upwards [hlog.eventually_gt_atTop 0] with N hN
  rw [sum_Icc_one_eq_range]
  have hh : (harmonic N : ℝ) = ∑ n ∈ Finset.range N, (1 : ℝ) / (n + 1) := by
    simp [harmonic, one_div]
  rw [hh]
  simp only [Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one]
  field_simp
  ring

private theorem mean_of_centered {f : ℕ → ℝ} {B L : ℝ}
    (h : Tendsto (fun N : ℕ => ∑ n ∈ Finset.Icc 1 N, (f n - B) / n)
      atTop (𝓝 L)) :
    Tendsto (fun N : ℕ => (∑ n ∈ Finset.Icc 1 N, f n / n) / Real.log N)
      atTop (𝓝 B) := by
  have hlog : Tendsto (fun N : ℕ => Real.log N) atTop atTop :=
    Real.tendsto_log_atTop.comp tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop
  have ht := (h.div_atTop hlog).add (tendsto_harmonic_weight_div_log.const_mul B)
  simp only [mul_one, zero_add] at ht
  apply ht.congr
  intro N
  simp only [sub_div, Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
  rw [← mul_div_assoc, Finset.mul_sum]
  simp only [mul_one_div]
  ring

/-- Both coordinates of the actual logarithmic first mean equal the residue. -/
theorem forwardCoeff_harmonic_mean {lam : ℕ → ℝ} (hW : WeilPositiveFull lam) :
    Tendsto (fun N : ℕ => (∑ n ∈ Finset.Icc 1 N, (forwardCoeff lam n).re / n) /
      Real.log N) atTop (𝓝 (WeilWorkSettledPhase.sourceCompletion hW 1).re) ∧
    Tendsto (fun N : ℕ => (∑ n ∈ Finset.Icc 1 N, (forwardCoeff lam n).im / n) /
      Real.log N) atTop (𝓝 (WeilWorkSettledPhase.sourceCompletion hW 1).im) := by
  obtain ⟨L, hL⟩ := exists_centered_forward_harmonic_limit hW
  constructor
  · apply mean_of_centered (L := L.re)
    have ht := (Complex.continuous_re.tendsto L).comp hL
    simpa only [Function.comp_def, Complex.re_sum, ← Complex.ofReal_natCast,
      Complex.div_ofReal_re, Complex.sub_re] using ht
  · apply mean_of_centered (L := L.im)
    have ht := (Complex.continuous_im.tendsto L).comp hL
    simpa only [Function.comp_def, Complex.im_sum, ← Complex.ofReal_natCast,
      Complex.div_ofReal_im, Complex.sub_im] using ht

The final theorem has only the original full-positivity premise. Residues and

private theorem summable_centered_source {lam : ℕ → ℝ} (hW : WeilPositiveFull lam)
    {s : ℝ} (hs : 1 < s) :
    LSeriesSummable (fun n => sourceCoeff lam n - sourceCompletion hW 1) (s : ℂ) := by
  have hc : LSeriesSummable (fun _ : ℕ => sourceCompletion hW 1) (s : ℂ) := by
    have he : (sourceCompletion hW 1) • (1 : ℕ → ℂ) =
        fun _ : ℕ => sourceCompletion hW 1 := by ext n; simp
    rw [← he]
    exact (LSeriesSummable_one_iff.mpr (show 1 < (s : ℂ).re from hs)).smul _
  exact (sourceCoeff_LSeries hW (s := (s : ℂ)) hs).1.sub hc

private theorem centered_source_residue {lam : ℕ → ℝ} (hW : WeilPositiveFull lam) :
    Tendsto (fun s : ℝ => ((s : ℂ) - 1) *
      LSeries (fun n => sourceCoeff lam n - sourceCompletion hW 1) (s : ℂ))
      (𝓝[>] 1) (𝓝 (0 : ℂ)) := by
  let B := sourceCompletion hW 1
  have ht := (forward_source_residue hW).sub (constant_one_residue.const_mul B)
  simp only [mul_one] at ht
  change Tendsto _ _ (𝓝 (B - B)) at ht
  rw [sub_self] at ht
  apply ht.congr'
  filter_upwards [self_mem_nhdsWithin] with s hs
  have he : (fun n => sourceCoeff lam n - B) = sourceCoeff lam - B • (1 : ℕ → ℂ) := by
    ext n; simp
  rw [he, LSeries_sub (sourceCoeff_LSeries hW (s := (s : ℂ)) hs).1
    ((LSeriesSummable_one_iff.mpr (show 1 < (s : ℂ).re from hs)).smul B), LSeries_smul]
  ring

private theorem centered_coprime_source_residue {lam : ℕ → ℝ}
    (hW : WeilPositiveFull lam) (Q : ℕ) [NeZero Q] {r : ℝ}
    (hr : Tendsto (fun s : ℝ => LSeries (coprimePart Q (sourceCoeff lam)) (s : ℂ) /
      LSeries (sourceCoeff lam) (s : ℂ)) (𝓝[>] 1) (𝓝 (r : ℂ))) :
    Tendsto (fun s : ℝ => ((s : ℂ) - 1) *
      LSeries (coprimePart Q (fun n => sourceCoeff lam n - sourceCompletion hW 1)) (s : ℂ))
      (𝓝[>] 1) (𝓝 (sourceCompletion hW 1 * ((r - coprimeDensity Q : ℝ) : ℂ))) := by
  let B := sourceCompletion hW 1
  have ha : Tendsto (fun s : ℝ => ((s : ℂ) - 1) *
      LSeries (coprimePart Q (sourceCoeff lam)) (s : ℂ))
      (𝓝[>] 1) (𝓝 ((r : ℂ) * B)) := by
    apply (hr.mul (forward_source_residue hW)).congr'
    filter_upwards [self_mem_nhdsWithin] with s hs
    have hn : LSeries (sourceCoeff lam) (s : ℂ) ≠ 0 := by
      rw [(sourceCoeff_LSeries hW (s := (s : ℂ)) hs).2, IntegerMassRigidity.zetaOf]
      exact Complex.exp_ne_zero _
    field_simp [hn]
  have ht := ha.sub ((coprimePart_one_residue Q).const_mul B)
  have he : (r : ℂ) * B - B * (coprimeDensity Q : ℂ) =
      B * ((r - coprimeDensity Q : ℝ) : ℂ) := by push_cast; ring
  rw [he] at ht
  apply ht.congr'
  filter_upwards [self_mem_nhdsWithin] with s hs
  have hec : coprimePart Q (fun n => sourceCoeff lam n - B) =
      coprimePart Q (sourceCoeff lam) - B • coprimePart Q 1 := by
    ext n
    simp only [coprimePart, Pi.sub_apply, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, Pi.one_apply, mul_one]
    ring
  rw [hec, LSeries_sub (summable_coprimePart Q
    (sourceCoeff_LSeries hW (s := (s : ℂ)) hs).1)
    ((summable_coprimePart Q
      (LSeriesSummable_one_iff.mpr (show 1 < (s : ℂ).re from hs))).smul B), LSeries_smul]
  ring

/-- Every finite coprime combination is charged to one actual source variance. -/
theorem exists_forward_coprime_covariance {lam : ℕ → ℝ} (hW : WeilPositiveFull lam) :
    ∃ (V : ℝ) (r : ℕ → ℝ), 0 ≤ V ∧
      Tendsto (fun N : ℕ => (∑ n ∈ Finset.Icc 1 N,
        ‖sourceCoeff lam n - sourceCompletion hW 1‖ ^ 2 / n) / Real.log N)
        atTop (𝓝 V) ∧
      (∀ Q : ℕ, Q ≠ 0 → 0 < r Q ∧
        Tendsto (fun s : ℝ => LSeries (coprimePart Q (sourceCoeff lam)) (s : ℂ) /
          LSeries (sourceCoeff lam) (s : ℂ)) (𝓝[>] 1) (𝓝 (r Q : ℂ))) ∧
      ∀ (S : Finset ℕ), (∀ Q ∈ S, Q ≠ 0) → ∀ c : ℕ → ℝ,
        ‖sourceCompletion hW 1‖ ^ 2 *
          (∑ Q ∈ S, c Q * (r Q - coprimeDensity Q)) ^ 2 ≤
        V * ∑ Q ∈ S, ∑ R ∈ S, c Q * c R *
          (coprimeDensity (Q * R) - coprimeDensity Q * coprimeDensity R) := by
  classical
  obtain ⟨_, V, _, hV0, _, _, hV⟩ := exists_forwardCoeff_energy_variance hW
  simp only [forwardCoeff_eq_sourceCoeff] at hV
  have hex (Q : ℕ) : ∃ r : ℝ, Q ≠ 0 → 0 < r ∧
      Tendsto (fun s : ℝ => LSeries (coprimePart Q (sourceCoeff lam)) (s : ℂ) /
        LSeries (sourceCoeff lam) (s : ℂ)) (𝓝[>] 1) (𝓝 (r : ℂ)) := by
    by_cases hQ : Q = 0
    · exact ⟨0, fun h => (h hQ).elim⟩
    haveI : NeZero Q := ⟨hQ⟩
    obtain ⟨r, _, _, hr, _, _, hRatio, _⟩ := exists_coprime_source_ratio_limit hW Q
    exact ⟨r, fun _ => ⟨hr, hRatio⟩⟩
  choose r hr using hex
  refine ⟨V, r, hV0, hV, hr, ?_⟩
  intro S hS c
  let B := sourceCompletion hW 1
  let f : ℕ → ℂ := fun n => sourceCoeff lam n - B

/-!
# The ordinary source harmonic limit is nonpositive

The centered source series is holomorphic across one by ordinary Dirichlet
convergence. Its value there identifies the ordinary harmonic limit with
the signed Gaussian pole coefficient. No local-mass premise is used.
-/

open Complex MeasureTheory Set Filter Topology
open GaloisForLFunctions.RHTower

noncomputable section

namespace RHTower.WeilSingularArithmetic

theorem centered_source_dirichletSum_one {lam : ℕ → ℝ} (hW : WeilPositiveFull lam) :
    dirichletSum (fun n => WeilHerglotz.lamC lam (n + 1) - 1) 1 =
      sourcePoleNumerator hW 1 - 2 * (Real.eulerMascheroniConstant : ℂ) := by
  let b : ℕ → ℂ := fun n => WeilHerglotz.lamC lam (n + 1) - 1
  have hb {s : ℂ} (hs : 1 / 2 < s.re) : DirichletConvergesAt b s :=
    centered_source_dirichletConvergesAt hW hs
  have hc : ContinuousAt (dirichletSum b) 1 :=
    ((differentiableOn_dirichletSum (hb (s := (3 / 4 : ℂ)) (by norm_num))).differentiableAt
      ((isOpen_lt continuous_const Complex.continuous_re).mem_nhds (by norm_num))).continuousAt
  have he {s : ℂ} (hs : 1 < s.re) : dirichletSum b s =
      zetaArchimedeanDatum s - WeilSpectral.weilContinuation hW s -
        (riemannZeta s - 1 / (s - 1)) := by
    have hl : LSeriesSummable (WeilHerglotz.lamC lam - 1) s :=
      LSeriesSummable.sub (WeilHerglotz.summable_term_lamC hW hs) (LSeriesSummable_one_iff.mpr hs)
    have hh : HasSum (fun n => LSeries.term (WeilHerglotz.lamC lam - 1) s (n + 1))
        (LSeries (WeilHerglotz.lamC lam - 1) s) := by
      have := (hasSum_nat_add_iff' 1).mpr hl.LSeriesHasSum
      simpa [LSeries.term_zero] using this
    have ht : Tendsto (fun N => dirichletPartialSum b N s) atTop
        (𝓝 (LSeries (WeilHerglotz.lamC lam - 1) s)) := by
      refine hh.tendsto_sum_nat.congr fun N => Finset.sum_congr rfl fun n _ => ?_
      exact term_succ_eq (WeilHerglotz.lamC lam - 1) s n
    rw [tendsto_nhds_unique (tendsto_dirichletSum (hb (by linarith))) ht,
      LSeries_sub (WeilHerglotz.summable_term_lamC hW hs) (LSeriesSummable_one_iff.mpr hs),
      LSeries_one_eq_riemannZeta hs, WeilSpectral.weilContinuation_eq hW hs,
      WeilHerglotz.weilFunction, zetaArchimedeanDatum]
    ring
  have hR : ContinuousAt (fun s : ℂ => zetaArchimedeanDatum s -
      WeilSpectral.weilContinuation hW s) 1 :=
    (WeilFiniteType.differentiableAt_zetaArchimedeanDatum (by norm_num)).continuousAt.sub
      ((WeilSpectral.differentiableOn_weilContinuation hW).differentiableAt
        ((isOpen_lt continuous_const Complex.continuous_re).mem_nhds (by norm_num))).continuousAt
  have hcast := tendsto_ofReal_nhdsWithin_ne_one.mono_right nhdsWithin_le_nhds
  have ht := (hR.tendsto.comp hcast).sub tendsto_riemannZeta_sub_pole_real
  have hd := hc.tendsto.comp hcast
  have ht' : Tendsto (fun σ : ℝ => dirichletSum b (σ : ℂ)) (𝓝[>] 1)
      (𝓝 (zetaArchimedeanDatum 1 - WeilSpectral.weilContinuation hW 1 -
        (Real.eulerMascheroniConstant : ℂ))) := by
    refine ht.congr' ?_
    filter_upwards [self_mem_nhdsWithin] with σ hσ
    exact (he (s := (σ : ℂ)) hσ).symm
  change dirichletSum b 1 = _
  rw [tendsto_nhds_unique hd ht', sourcePoleNumerator_one]
  ring

theorem tendsto_coneDeviation_harmonic_pole {lam : ℕ → ℝ} (hW : WeilPositiveFull lam) :
    Tendsto (fun N : ℕ => ∑ n ∈ Finset.range (N + 1),
      WeilOneSided.coneDeviation lam n / n) atTop (𝓝 (sourcePoleNumerator hW 1).re) := by
  let v : ℕ → ℝ := fun n => if 2 ≤ n then lam n else 0
  let b : ℕ → ℂ := fun n => WeilHerglotz.lamC lam (n + 1) - 1
  have hL := tendsto_dirichletSum (centered_source_dirichletConvergesAt hW (s := 1) (by norm_num))
  have hc : Tendsto (fun N : ℕ => ∑ n ∈ Finset.range N,
      (v (n + 1) - 1) / ((n : ℝ) + 1)) atTop (𝓝 (dirichletSum b 1).re) := by
    have ht (n : ℕ) : ((v (n + 1) : ℂ) - 1) *
        ((((n : ℝ) + 1 : ℝ) : ℂ) ^ (-(1 : ℂ))) =
        (((v (n + 1) - 1) / ((n : ℝ) + 1) : ℝ) : ℂ) := by
      rw [Complex.cpow_neg_one]
      push_cast
      rfl
    have hreal := Complex.continuous_re.tendsto _ |>.comp hL
    refine hreal.congr fun N => ?_
    change (∑ n ∈ Finset.range N, ((v (n + 1) : ℂ) - 1) *
      ((((n : ℝ) + 1 : ℝ) : ℂ) ^ (-(1 : ℂ)))).re = _
    simp_rw [ht]
    rw [← Complex.ofReal_sum]
    rfl
  have hh : Tendsto (fun N : ℕ => (∑ n ∈ Finset.range (N + 1),
      1 / ((n : ℝ) + 1)) - Real.log ((N : ℝ) + 1)) atTop
      (𝓝 Real.eulerMascheroniConstant) := by
    have ht := Real.tendsto_harmonic_sub_log.comp (tendsto_add_atTop_nat 1)
    refine ht.congr fun N => ?_
    simp [harmonic, Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one, one_div]
  have hdev := ((hc.comp (tendsto_add_atTop_nat 1)).add hh).sub tendsto_vonMangoldt_harmonicWeighted
  have heL : ((dirichletSum b 1).re + Real.eulerMascheroniConstant) -
      (Real.eulerMascheroniConstant + mertensAbelTail) = (sourcePoleNumerator hW 1).re := by
    dsimp only [b]

/-!
# The actual source after matching the zeta pole

The divided difference of the source pole numerator removes its singularity
at one. Subtracting the regularized zeta function then gives a holomorphic
function whose literal critical trace is the source trace minus its residue
times zeta. Its Dirichlet coefficients and growth are supplied by full positivity.
-/

open Complex Set Filter MeasureTheory Topology GaloisForLFunctions
noncomputable section
namespace RHTower.WeilSpectral
open TruncatedRadial WeilWorkSettledPhase WeilSingularArithmetic
variable {lam : ℕ → ℝ}

/-- The holomorphic numerator of the source's simple pole. -/
def quantizationPoleNumerator (hW : WeilPositiveFull lam) (s : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  sourceCompletion hW s / (s * Gammaℝ s)

@[simp] theorem quantizationPoleNumerator_one (hW : WeilPositiveFull lam) :
    quantizationPoleNumerator hW 1 = sourceCompletion hW 1 := by
  simp [quantizationPoleNumerator, Gammaℝ_one]

theorem differentiableOn_quantizationPoleNumerator (hW : WeilPositiveFull lam) :
    DifferentiableOn ℂ (quantizationPoleNumerator hW) {s : ℂ | 1 / 2 < s.re} := by
  intro s hs
  change 1 / 2 < s.re at hs
  have hs0 : s ≠ 0 := by intro h; simp [h] at hs; linarith
  exact ((hasDerivAt_sourceCompletion hW hs).differentiableAt.div
    (differentiableAt_id.mul (differentiableAt_Gammaℝ (by linarith)))
    (mul_ne_zero hs0 (Gammaℝ_ne_zero_of_re_pos (by linarith)))).differentiableWithinAt

/-- The source with the same polar zeta contribution removed, filled at one. -/
def quantizationCenteredProdF (hW : WeilPositiveFull lam) (s : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  dslope (quantizationPoleNumerator hW) 1 s - sourceCompletion hW 1 * riemannZeta₀ s

theorem differentiableOn_quantizationCenteredProdF (hW : WeilPositiveFull lam) :
    DifferentiableOn ℂ (quantizationCenteredProdF hW) {s : ℂ | 1 / 2 < s.re} := by
  have hd := (Complex.differentiableOn_dslope
    ((isOpen_lt continuous_const Complex.continuous_re).mem_nhds
      (by norm_num : (1 : ℂ) ∈ {s : ℂ | 1 / 2 < s.re}))).mpr
        (differentiableOn_quantizationPoleNumerator hW)
  exact hd.sub ((differentiable_riemannZeta₀.differentiableOn).const_mul _)

theorem quantizationCenteredProdF_eq (hW : WeilPositiveFull lam)
    {s : ℂ} (hs : s ≠ 1) :
    quantizationCenteredProdF hW s = prodF (quantizationCompletion hW) s -
      sourceCompletion hW 1 * riemannZeta s := by
  rw [quantizationCenteredProdF, dslope_of_ne _ hs, slope_def_module,
    quantizationPoleNumerator_one, riemannZeta_eq_inv_sub_add hs]
  change (s - 1)⁻¹ * (sourceCompletion hW s / (s * Gammaℝ s) - sourceCompletion hW 1) - _ =
    sourceCompletion hW s / (s * (s - 1) * Gammaℝ s) - _
  simp only [div_eq_mul_inv, mul_inv_rev]
  ring

/-- Literal centered coefficients, with the unused zero coefficient normalized to zero. -/
def quantizationCenteredCoeff (hW : WeilPositiveFull lam) (n : ℕ) : ℂ :=
  if n = 0 then 0 else sourceCoeff lam n - sourceCompletion hW 1

@[simp] theorem quantizationCenteredCoeff_zero (hW : WeilPositiveFull lam) :
    quantizationCenteredCoeff hW 0 = 0 := by simp [quantizationCenteredCoeff]

theorem quantizationCenteredCoeff_summable (hW : WeilPositiveFull lam)
    {s : ℂ} (hs : 1 < s.re) : LSeriesSummable (quantizationCenteredCoeff hW) s := by
  have hc := (LSeriesSummable_one_iff.mpr hs).smul (sourceCompletion hW 1)
  have hh := (sourceCoeff_LSeries hW hs).1.sub hc
  refine (LSeriesSummable_congr s ?_).mpr hh
  intro n hn
  simp [quantizationCenteredCoeff, hn]

theorem quantizationCenteredCoeff_LSeries (hW : WeilPositiveFull lam)
    {s : ℂ} (hs : 1 < s.re) :
